result.finding: Minimal instrumentation — no structured logging framework, no APM/telemetry, and no AOP configured. The application uses System.out.println() for basic console output. Spring Boot 3.3.0 includes SLF4J/Logback on the classpath (via spring-boot-starter) but no logging configuration or logger instances are explicitly initialized.
evidence: Producer.java line 21: System.out.println('Sending message...'+i) — plain console output only
No logback.xml, logback-spring.xml, or log4j2.xml configuration files found
No LoggerFactory.getLogger() or LogManager.getLogger() calls in source code
No micrometer, opentelemetry, applicationinsights, or APM dependencies in pom.xml
SLF4J/Logback available on classpath via spring-boot-starter-test (test scope only)
